0022600092.text: Both the Phoenix Suns and Portland Trail Blazers open their 2026-27 seasons, with Phoenix visiting Portland. The Suns are without Mark Williams, who is out following shoulder surgery, while Luke Kennard (knee strain) and Oso Ighodaro (rest) are day-to-day and game-time decisions. Portland is without Shaedon Sharpe, who is out following knee surgery, and Chris Youngblood (calf soreness), Jrue Holiday (hand soreness), Micah Potter (illness), and Robert Williams III (rest) are all day-to-day and game-time decisions, while Suns in 2025-26 won the season series 2-1, and in their last meeting, on February 22, 2026 in Phoenix, the Suns lost 92-77, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives Phoenix a 40% chance to win.
